question: In a circular race of 500 m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time at speeds of 36 km/hr and 45 km/hr in the same direction. After how long will they meet again for the first time on the track?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert speeds to m/s: A = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s, B = 45 × (5/18) = 12.5 m/s.

Because they run in the same direction, Relative Speed = 12.5 − 10 = 2.5 m/s.

Time to meet = Track Length ÷ Relative Speed = 500 ÷ 2.5 = 200 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 200 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 500 m

Speed of A = 36 km/hr

Speed of B = 45 km/hr
